title: The Right of Resistance and Early Constitutional Compacts

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Issued by King Andrew II in 1222, just seven years after the Magna Carta, the *Aranybulla* was Hungary's seminal charter of liberties (*szabadságlevél*). Its famous 31st article granted the nobility the legal right of resistance (*jus resistendi*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Crucially, resistance against an unlawful monarch was not considered treason (*hűtlenség*), but a lawful act of constitutional preservation (*a törvények védelme*).
